subject: Invitation to speak at POWER 2000
body:
Hi Vince

It is my great pleasure to invite you to speak at POWER 2000 which will be in Houston on 9 & 10 May 2000.

Would you be interested in chairing one of the streams on day 2 of the conference? Please could you get back to me asap on 212 925 1864 Ext 151 or by return email.

Best regards

Emma
